name: TITAN COMPACT CHAMPIONSHIP: Season 19
description: By Season 19, the TITAN COMPACT has become the most-watched sporting property in Meridian 88, a fully corporate-owned augmented combat league where fighter augmentation is funded, designed, and owned by the sponsoring corponation — meaning fighters are contractually obligated to use only their sponsor's chrome, creating dramatic matchups that double as live product demonstrations. Fighters compete in individual and team elimination formats across purpose-built arenas in Tiers 3 through 5, with the Season 19 championship broadcast drawing an estimated 340 million viewers across the Great Lakes corridor. The Compact's governing body is a committee of corponation representatives with no independent members.
story_hooks: A TITAN COMPACT fighter discovers that the proprietary chrome installed by her corporate sponsor contains a kill-switch — and she has just been informed she is being 'retired' from her contract.
A Shelf-born journalist obtains the leaked fighter welfare documents and must decide whether to publish knowing the corporate response will be swift and personal.
A Season 19 championship match is fixed — but the fixer is not a gambler, they are trying to send a message to a specific corponation executive watching from a private box.
